notes.title: The Pirate Kings Exclusive Campaign is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/1817bd877a1c5926af7dde453cda0d64de086ed2.jpg[/img]
General, the time has come to show those so-called "Pirate Kings" who truly rules these waters!
My formidable Dark Army stands ready, awaiting your command to strike and reclaim my rightful lands.

To aid your conquest, I have put at your disposal a new tower, the Ogre Shipwreck, manned by my most merciless warmongers. And the ghostly Captain Lucerna of the Haunted Galleon shall join you, her specter powers ready to make those knaves Walk the Plank!

Be swift and vigilant, General, for those cowards will be expecting our arrival. I intercepted their pathetic attempts to "warn each other" of our army - as if that would make a lick of difference to my plans! 

[b]Now, make those swindlers face my Vengeance, once and for all![/b]

notes.title: The Hammerhold Campaign DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/658fea414d298df08be9e42a05b4f44498ceb8f5.jpg[/img]

Did my ears deceive me? King Malik?[b] KING MALIK[/b]? [b]The audacity! [/b]Have they all taken leave of their senses, forgetting the true sovereign that reigns supreme in this Kingdom?

Did they ACTUALLY believe Hammerhold could stand a chance against my Dark Army? Until now, I merely dismissed them, occupied with more important matters. But no longer.

Now, General, seize the hour! Lead a surprise assault on the desert’s shores, catching them off guard. Let’s wake them up from their delusions and get this little rebellion done and over with.

[b]Let our dark dominance be absolute! 
[i]Take my Vengeance to Hammerhold once and for all!![/i][/b]


[h3]What's in the Hammerhold DLC:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]5 new stages:[/b] A whole new campaign packed with action and powerful enemies. 
[*] [b]3 minibosses and 1 boss: [/b]Familiar faces are back… and they’re not thrilled to see you!
[*] [b]New hero: [/b] Behold Isfet, a formidable mummy warlock with an arsenal of curses. 
[*] [b]New tower:[/b] The Sandworm Hollows' appetites are (mostly) at your disposal.
[*] [b]New achievements: [/b]And savor the sweet taste of bragging rights that come with them!
[*] [b]Easter eggs galore: [/b]The desert may hold secrets, but it also has a sense of humor.
[/list]

[b]Get it now:[/b]

notes.title: Ultra joins the fight! The definition of ‘bravery’ is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/1d180d73b376ab8f7b5b742513ae1c52e476ecff.png[/img]

[INCOMING TRANSMISSION - CAP TAGGINS - 52623]

Marine, hope you're coping well with the snowy and hostile conditions at YCYCL III.

It's time for your Squad to push through the Vultures to the rendezvous point. We just deployed the Federation's top elite agent, Ultra, to watch the six of you and ensure the mission succeeds.

She is a true warrior. The very definition of “bravery”. You'll see what I mean.

Take a look at her profile on the data pad, and don't get too distracted by the multitude of awards and decorations. It's the story behind them that makes her truly outstanding. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/5c20f286b13ffb6c46f36c2bf9ccbc42b71d4b53.gif[/img]

See, her platoon was pinned down by the savage Fell. The conditions were so relentless that Federation Headquarters considered the BRAVO TEAM lost. Ultra wouldn't accept that. She powered through, and alone with her fierce willpower, managed to rescue them all.

But it was not without consequences. This heroic action cost her an arm and an eye, later replaced by cybernetic-enhanced prosthetics. 

The platoon vowed to follow her on any mission from then on. She became an inspiration to them. A symbol of loyalty, resilience, and courage. A true leader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/e2b55856187b8456bf87510251b1de52b3322eaa.gif[/img]

And now she's stronger than ever. Her cybernetic armor withstands most damage directed at her, and her shotgun can deal with several enemies at once. Check out her tactical abilities on the data pad. I'm sure you'll find them handy on the field.

[list]
[*] SUPERSHELL: a high-powered, armor-piercing, single target 5 shotshell that pushes enemies away.
[*] BRAVO TEAM: Elite soldiers trained personally by Ultra, ready to be sent to the middle of any conflict. 
[/list]
You're in the best hands, Marine. Meet her at the rendezvous and you're guaranteed to succeed.

Oh! Don't forget to tell her I said hello. 
I'm a huge fan.

Taggins out.

[END OF TRANSMISSION]
